name: Sunside
beschreibung: The Sunside Gasthof is nestled in a peaceful corner of Tyrol, surrounded by green meadows and alpine forests. The property seamlessly blends authentic Tyrolean warmth with sleek, contemporary interiors. Guests can indulge in authentic regional flavours at the inviting on-site restaurant and unwind in the hotel's sauna after a fulfilling day on the mountain trails. Parking is conveniently available right at the property.
